title: introduce button(s) to skip an adjudication

issues.title: Adjudication - "Skip this"
issues.body:
After the player has clicked on "Get next interaction", if an interaction is found, then the interaction is created, the page updates, and the new form is opened.

An umpire may quickly decide "nothing to do here".  In this case, they would like a "Skip", in addition to "Submit adjudication".  For "Skip", the interaction is marked as complete, and no adjudication outcomes are sent.

The interaction generator may have suggested some outcomes.  But, when `Skip` is pressed, an empty adjudication outcomes document should be sent (but still with details marked as `Complete`).  This will capture the fact that the interaction has been considered.
